content:
Alex is the fictional owner of this public library and the research lead for
the [Neighborhood Atlas](/note/projects/neighborhood_atlas/neighborhood_atlas). Alex
collects questions, hosts walking interviews, and keeps the team aligned around
the principles in [Design principles](/note/notes/design_principles).

## Current threads

- Reviewing [research on third places](/note/notes/research/third_places) with Jamie
- Preparing the [Atlas open studio](/note/events/2026/atlas_open_studio)
- Turning observations from the [field day](/note/journal/2026-08-27_field_day) into stories
